Mr. Pankaj Chaturvedi, learned 
counsel for the revisionist.
2. Mr. Siddhartha Singh and Mr. 
Priyanshu Gairola, learned counsel for the 
respondent no.1.
3. Mr. Bhupendra Singh Bora, learned 
counsel holding brief of Mr. Shubhang 
Dobhal, learned counsel for respondent 
no.2.
4. Restoration application has been filed 
by the revisionist along with delay 
condonation application.
5. There is delay of 43 days in filing the 
restoration application, which has been 
satisfactorily explained by the applicant. 
Moreover, the delay in filing the restoration 
application is not opposed by learned 
counsel for the respondents. Accordingly,  the delay condonation application 
(IA/6/2026) is allowed and the delay in 
filing the restoration application is 
condoned.
6. Learned counsel for the revisionist 
has filed Restoration Application 
(MCC/5/2026) to recall the order dated 
08.05.2026 whereby the Civil Revision was 
dismissed in default.
7. For the reasons stated in the 
restoration application, the Restoration 
Application (MCC/5/2026) stands allowed. 
Consequently, order dated 08.05.2026 is 
hereby recalled. The Civil Revision is 
restored to its original number along with 
interim order dated 09.01.2024.
8. List on 07.08.2026.
9. Interim order dated 09.01.2024 is 
extended till the next date of listing.
 (Subhash Upadhyay,J.)
